memberships_decided_chk.name: memberships_decided_chk
memberships_decided_chk.value: "memberships"."status" NOT IN ('ACTIVE','REJECTED') OR "memberships"."decided_at" IS NOT NULL

pc_reviewed_chk.name: pc_reviewed_chk
pc_reviewed_chk.value: "pending_collections"."status" = 'PENDING' OR ("pending_collections"."reviewed_by_member_id" IS NOT NULL AND "pending_collections"."reviewed_at" IS NOT NULL)

hymn_media_source_chk.name: hymn_media_source_chk
hymn_media_source_chk.value: ("hymn_media"."kind" = 'YOUTUBE') = ("hymn_media"."youtube_id" IS NOT NULL) AND ("hymn_media"."kind" = 'YOUTUBE') = ("hymn_media"."object_key" IS NULL)

podcast_episodes_live_chk.name: podcast_episodes_live_chk
podcast_episodes_live_chk.value: "podcast_episodes"."status" = 'DRAFT' OR ("podcast_episodes"."published_at" IS NOT NULL AND (("podcast_episodes"."media_kind" = 'AUDIO' AND "podcast_episodes"."audio_key" IS NOT NULL) OR ("podcast_episodes"."media_kind" = 'YOUTUBE' AND "podcast_episodes"."youtube_id" IS NOT NULL)))

posts_event_chk.name: posts_event_chk
posts_event_chk.value: "posts"."kind" <> 'EVENT' OR "posts"."status" IN ('DRAFT','REJECTED') OR "posts"."starts_at" IS NOT NULL
